title: anthropic.stop_sequence
description: The custom stop sequence that actually ended generation, echoed on anthropic/messages response envelopes when stop_reason is `stop_sequence`. The canonical FinishInfo already carries the two-lane reason/native pair; WHICH configured sequence matched is provider-unique response metadata with no canonical home, so it rides ChatResponse.extensions with an EXTENSIONS FieldLoss — preserved and reported, never portable-by-pretense.
x-ocai-promotion: promote onto a typed FinishInfo detail if a second provider echoes the matched stop sequence
